description: Use when writing backend or API-key integration code for Didit Phone Verification, the standalone API that verifies phone numbers with a one-time code and risk-scores a number without sending a code. Use when the user wants to send SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, voice, RCS, Viber or Zalo codes, check phone verification codes, detect disposable or VoIP numbers, flag duplicate or blocklisted numbers, look up a number's carrier, line type or social footprint, or score phone risk with POST /v3/phone/risk/ using Didit. Supports automatic SMS fallback, branded SMS sender names, fraud signals, and per-call DECLINE policies.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
